integrity: Original self-contained mathematical proof and an independently constructed exact-rational finite-case checker included; no external mathematical audit or certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact statements concern only real dual Lipschitz balls of unit-edge complete bipartite metrics with both parts of size at least two; no primal-ball, weighted-edge or independent-certification assertion is made. Numerical hull triangulation is used only for finite-instance corroboration, with exact rational integration. The 2018 normalized-volume and facet predecessors are credited. Equivalent unindexed previous calculations remain possible.
title: Beta disintegration and exact bulk covariance of complete-bipartite Lipschitz dual balls
